{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Cross-tabulate sex and severity to check for imbalance
sex_severity_ct = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['severity'])
print('Cross-tabulation of sex and severity:\n', sex_severity_ct)

# Cross-tabulate sex and arm to check for imbalance
sex_arm_ct = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['arm'])
print('\nCross-tabulation of sex and arm:\n', sex_arm_ct)

# Check if severity or arm distribution differs by sex
# This will help determine if the observed response difference is confounded

# Compute weighted response rate by sex, adjusting for severity
# First, compute response rate within each severity level by sex
response_by_sex_severity = df.groupby(['sex', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().unstack(level='severity')
print('\nResponse rate by sex and severity:\n', response_by_sex_severity)

# Check if the distribution of severity differs by sex
severity_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True).unstack(fill_value=0)
print('\nSeverity distribution by sex:\n', severity_by_sex)"}
